certification.name: IACIS Certified Mobile Device Examiner
certification.description: Mobile device forensics certification with an open-book written exam and a practical exam on supplied image files, each with a 48-hour time limit and an 80% pass mark. Recertification requires a proficiency exercise and 40 hours of continuing education.
certification.currency_note: External certification fee (certification only, training not included); external candidates must show 36 hours of relevant training; fee is waived for students of the matching IACIS course
